nodes.name: impeccable
nodes.summary: POSIX shell launcher that resolves and execs the Impeccable engine binary from sibling bin paths, home cache, or version-pinned download using VERSION and IMPECCABLE_SKILL_DIR.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses engine-probe handshake to reject legacy npm CLI binaries named impeccable.

nodes.name: impeccable.cmd
nodes.summary: Windows batch launcher mirroring the POSIX impeccable script: resolves sibling or cached engine binaries, validates via engine-probe, and downloads with SHA256 verification.

nodes.name: createLiveBrowserDomHelpers
nodes.summary: Factory that builds DOM utilities for live overlay chrome: pickable element filtering, frozen anchors, UI root mounting, and event defanging.

nodes.name: live-browser-ignores.js
nodes.summary: Browser-side resolver for Impeccable detector ignore rules, mirroring CLI config to suppress findings or skip scans based on page URL and project globs.

nodes.name: resolveDetectIgnores
nodes.summary: Resolves serialized project ignore config against the current pathname to produce disabled rules, disabled values, or a skipScan flag for live detector scans.

nodes.name: live-browser-session.js
nodes.summary: Durable localStorage session helpers for Impeccable live mode, attached to window.__IMPECCABLE_LIVE_SESSION__ for recovery without booting the full overlay UI.

nodes.name: createLiveBrowserSessionState
nodes.summary: Factory for prefixed localStorage session state including save/load/clear, handled-variant tracking, scroll position persistence, and checkpoint revision.

nodes.name: live-browser.js
nodes.summary: Large injected browser script (~13k lines) implementing Impeccable Live Variant Mode: floating Spotlight-style UI, element picking, variant generation cycling, HMR hot-swap, screenshots, and localhost server integration.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE guarded by __IMPECCABLE_LIVE_INIT__; composes session, DOM, and ignore helper modules via window globals.

nodes.name: modern-screenshot.umd.js
nodes.summary: Minified UMD bundle of the modern-screenshot library exposing domToCanvas, domToPng, and related DOM-to-image capture APIs for live-mode screenshots.
